day_local: Xuska Saint Teresa ee Ciise, Gabar Quduus ah oo ahayd Dhakhtar Kaniisadda
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Alle Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jiraan maanta iyo weligiis.

homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo markaad kormeerto guriga, oo aad aragto kabaha wiilka oo ku xiran albaabka geeskiisa, ama buug xisaabeed uu iska dhigay miiska agtiisa, halkaas oo ay ka muuqato inuu halkaas joogay kaliya daqiiqad ka hor. Alaabtaas yaryar, ee aan hadlin, waxay xambaarsan yihiin raadadka nolol dhab ah oo weli ku nool guryahan iyo quluubtanada. Maanta, marka aan isugu nimid xuskan Quduuska ah ee Saint Teresa ee Ciise, waxaan eegaynaa meel qoto dheer oo nolosheenna ka mid ah, annagoo ku hakanaya xusuusta wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, Benjamin Vo, kaas oo hadda ka tagay adduunkan muddo afar bilood ah, balse jacaylkiisu uu weli halkan ka dhex guuxayo sida webi degdeg ah oo aan weligiis oollin.

Waxaan maanta dooraneynaa hal sawir oo aan la socon doono akhriska: waa 'furaha la qariyey' oo laga hadlay Injiilka. Ciise wuxuu ku yiri culimada sharciga: 'Waxaad qaadateen furaha aqoonta; idinku ma aydin gelin, oo kuwa gelayaana waad ka celiseen.' Bal ka feker sawirkaas qoto dheer. Furaha. Waa shay yar, laakiin wuxuu furaa albaab weyn oo qol mugdi ah ku jira. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax furnaan iyo furayaal badan oo cajiib ah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil dhalinyaro ah oo si dabiici ah u fahmayey xisaabta adag, daruuraha casriga ah ee kombuyuutarka, iyo nidaamyada AI ee ay dadka qaarkood ku qaataan sannado badan inay bartaan. Laakiin ka baxsan caqligiisa baaxadda leh, furaha ugu weyn ee Ben gacanta ugu jiray ma ahayn mid farsamo; wuxuu ahaa furaha naxariiska iyo jacaylka saafiga ah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu dhoola caddayn la wadaago qof kasta oo agtiisa jooga.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka weyn ee maanta halkan yaalla. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo qoto dheer oo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira saacado marka qorraxdu dhacdo ama marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara cisrigaas banaanka ah. Waxaa maskaxdiinna kusoo dhaca su'aasha ah: 'Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin? Ma seegnay wax yar?' Waan ogahay in xanuunkan uu yahay mid mararka qaarkood culus oo aan la qaadi karin. Laakiin maanta, erayada Ilaah iyo naxariistiisa waxay rabaan inay meesha ka saaraan culayskaas. Haku noolaan eedeyn aan jirin. Cudurka AML ee soo ritay Ben ma ahan guuldarro waalid, mana aha ciqaab ka timid samada. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Wuxuu ahaa shay ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof eed leh. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qalbigooda oo dhan u hurey wiilkooda, jacaylkiinnuna wuxuu ahaa kii ugu wanaagsanaa ee wiil heli karo. Ha is-eedeynin; ha qaadan culays uusan Ilaah kugu amrin in aad qaadato. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idiinku xusuustaa jacayl iyo sharaf.

Ooh, halkaas ayay nuurku ka galayaa qolka. Markaan eegno Injiilka, waxaa jira digniin adag oo ku socota kuwa aan aqoonsaneyn runta, laakiin dhinaca kale, waxaa jira ballanqaad weyn oo ah in xigmadda Ilaah ay soo dirto nebiyo iyo rasuullo si ay noo soo gaarsiiyaan iftiinka. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil gucleynayay oo jeclaa inuu arko adduunka, laga yaabee inuu maskaxdiisa ku dhisayay shirkad duulimaad oo uu u bixiyay 'con chim airlines', halkaas oo uu ka qosli jiray oo uu si farxad leh uga sheekeyn jiray isagoo diyaaradaha daawanaya. Xusuuso sida uu aabihiis ugu sheegay riyadii uu ku arkay Ben oo caafimaad qaba, oo leh pantalon cagaaran oo soo jiidasho leh, isagoo dhahaya: 'Baah, test nào con cũng qua hết... con tự thở được bình thường mà.' Haa, Ben wuxuu gudbay imtixaankii nolosha si sharaf leh. Hadda, ma jiro wax xanuun ah oo haysta. Wuxuu joogaa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, halkaas oo uu kaga qayb qaadanayo 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo farxad iyo nabad ku qaba gacmaha Aabbaha iyo hooyada Jannada, Maryan.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood kursiga Ben ee agtaada uu yahay mid madhan, laakiin xusuuso in jacaylkiisuu uusan marna dhimanayn. Wuxuu ku jiraa wadnahaaga, wuxuu ku jiraa xusuustaada, wuxuu kaloo ku sugayaa mustaqbalka. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba ku jeclaa.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad xanuunkaaga u dhiibto gacmaha Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabaddaas weyn. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseyowga qaaliga ah, inkaanan hadda heli karin Eucharist-ka quduuska ah, waxaan kaa baryayaa in aad qalbigayga timaadid oo aad igu degtid ruux ahaan. Waxaan kuugu imid iimaan buuxa, ha ii oggolaanin inaan weligay kaa go'o, ee iga yeel mid adiga kuu gaar ah weligiis. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idinku barakeeyo oo ha idinku ilaaliyo; wuxuu idinka dusha saarayaa nuurkiisa iyo naxariistiisa maanta iyo weligiis. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: U ducee Benjamin iyo dhammaan inta naga tagtay, inay ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
U ducee dhammaan kuwa la ildaran murugada iyo xanuunka, in Ilaah siiyo dhiirigelin iyo rajo.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Bawlos, oo ah rasuul loogu yeeray xagga doonista Ilaah inuu ahaado rasuulkii Ciise Masiix, wuxuu u qorayaa kuwa quduuska ah ee jooga Efesos, kuwaas oo ku daacad ah Ciise Masiix: Nimco iyo nabad ha idin ka yimaadaan xagga Ilaah oo ah Aabbahaa iyo Rabbiga Ciise Masiix. Mahadnaq ha u ahaado Ilaaha iyo Aabbaha Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, kaas oo nagu barakeeyey Masiix kasta oo ah barako ruuxi ah oo ku jirta meelaha samada ah, siduu inoogu doortay isaga intaan aasaaska adduunka la dhigin, si aanu u noqono kuwo quduus ah oo aan eed lahayn hortiisa. Jacayl buu hore inoogu qaddaray inaan u noqono carruur uu isu korsado xagga Ciise Masiix, sidii ay ahayd raalli ahaanshaha doonistiisa, si loo ammaanayo ammaanta nimcadiisa oo uu nagu siiyey kan gacaliyaha ah. Isaga dhexdiisa ayaannu ku leenahay madax furasho xagga dhiiggiisa, taas oo ah cafiska xadgudubyada, siday tahay hodantinimada nimcadiisa oo uu nagu dul shubay xigmad iyo garasho oo dhan. Wuxuu inoo ogeysiiyey qarsoodiga doonistiisa, siday tahay raalli ahaanshaha uu isagu ku go'aansaday naftiisa, si loo fuliyo xilliga buuxankiisa, si uu wax walba ugu soo ururiyo Masiixu, kuwa samada iyo kuwa dhulka degganba.

readings.label: Sabuurka Jawaabta
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu ogeysiiyey badbaadadiisa. u heesa Rabbiga gabay cusub, waayo wuxuu falay yaabab; gacantiisa midig iyo Gacantiisa quduuska ah ayaa guul u keentay. R. Rabbigu wuxuu ogeysiiyey badbaadadiisa. Rabbigu wuxuu ogeysiiyey badbaadadiisa; indhaha quruumaha ayuu ku muujiyey xaqnimadiisa. Wuxuu xusuustay naxariistiisa iyo daacadnimadiisa ku aaddan reer Israa'iil. R. Rabbigu wuxuu ogeysiiyey badbaadadiisa. Dunida daafadeeda oo dhammu waxay arkeen badbaadada Ilaahayenna. Rabbiga ugu qayliya farxad, idinkoo dhulka oo dhan ah; qayliya oo heesa ammaan. R. Rabbigu wuxuu ogeysiiyey badbaadadiisa. Rabbiga ugu heesa kinni, kinni iyo hees macaan leh. Turunbooyin iyo shanqar geeso ah ku qayliya boqorka horta, oo ah Rabbiga. R. Rabbigu wuxuu ogeysiiyey badbaadadiisa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu yiri: «Ilaahayoow, waxaa iska leh kuwa dhisa xusuusta nebihii ay awowayaashiin dileen! Sidaas daraaddeed waxaad markhati ka tihiin oo aad oggolaataan falimihii awowayaashiin, maxaa yeelay, iyaga ayaa dilay, idinkuna waad dhistaan. Sidaas daraaddeed xigmadda Ilaahay waxay tiri: “Waxaan u soo diri doonaa nebiyo iyo rasuullo; qaar bay dili doonaan oo cadaadin doonaan,” si qarnigan loogu eedeeyo dhiigga nebiyadii oo dhan ee la daadiyey tan iyo aasaaskii adduunka, laga soo bilaabo dhiiggiisii ​​Abel ilaa dhiiggiisii ​​Sekariya oo ku dhintay meesha qiyaamaha iyo dhismaha macbudka dhexdooda. Haa, waxaan idinku leeyahay, qarnigan waxaa lagu eedayn doonaa dhiiggooda! «Ilaahayoow, waxaa iska leh culimada sharciga! Waxaad qaadateen furaha aqoonta; idinku ma aydin gelin, oo kuwa gelayaana waad ka celiseen.» Markii uu halkaas ka tagay, culimadii iyo Fariisiyadii waxay bilaabeen inay la dagaallamaan oo ay waxyaalo badan ka su'aalaan, iyagoo doonaya inay qabtaan wax ay afkiisa ka dhahaan.

day: Memorial of Saint Teresa of Jesus, Virgin and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
